deck.title: Crosspost — write it once, be everywhere it matters

props.title: Write it ==once==. Be everywhere it matters.
props.subtitle: One composer for X, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, and Tumblr.

slides.notes: Open with the pain everyone knows: you wrote one good post, and it only went to one network. Crosspost is the fix.

props.title: Five tabs. Five composers. Five ==slightly different== formats.
props.body: So people post to one place — and the rest of their audience never sees it.

slides.notes: Everyone with more than one account has felt this. The relay dies not from lack of ideas, but from lack of evening.

props.title: One post in. Five places out.

items.title: Compose once
items.body: One dashboard, one editor — no tab juggling.

items.title: Pick your networks
items.body: X, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon, Tumblr — any mix.

items.title: Crosspost adapts
items.body: Text, links, and images tuned per platform.

slides.notes: The key word is adapts — this is not paste-into-five-boxes. Each network gets its own properly formatted version.

tabs.label: X
tabs.content: Same thought, trimmed for the timeline: tight copy, link, image attached. Nothing cut off mid-sentence.

tabs.label: Bluesky
tabs.content: The full version — longer text fits natively, link card renders, image loads clean.

tabs.label: Threads
tabs.content: Conversational tone, no hashtag clutter, image framed for the feed.

tabs.label: Mastodon
tabs.content: Character count respected for your instance, alt text carried over, link kept inline.

tabs.label: Tumblr
tabs.content: Richer body text, image front and center — the format Tumblr readers expect.

slides.notes: Click through the tabs live. The point to land: per-platform previews mean nothing goes out looking broken.

props.title: From manual relay to automatic fan-out.

left.label: Tonight, manually
left.title: Copy-paste relay
points: Five tabs, five composers, every evening
Reformat text and images for each one
Skip a network and part of your audience never sees it

right.label: With Crosspost
right.title: Write once, fan out
points: Daily posts publish to every network automatically
Previews catch anything broken before it ships

slides.notes: This is the habit slide: Crosspost is not a one-off tool, it replaces a nightly chore you keep doing forever.
